translationRepairs: In Qianfu year 3 Li Guochang's son Keyong, of the Datong Army command, was Yunzhong defense commissioner; he slew the defense envoy, seized the prefecture, and sent word to court.

In Qianfu year 3 Li Guochang, Datong Army military commissioner, had a son Keyong who served as Yunzhong defense commissioner; Keyong slew the defense envoy, seized the prefecture, and sent word to court.
大同軍節度使 modifies Li Guochang; Keyong separately held the Yunzhong defense post.
In the first year of Yongchun Mochuo's raids harried the people, and the populace was relocated to Shuo.
In the first year of Yongchun, Mochuo's raids harried the people, and the populace was relocated to Shuo.
The comma correctly separates the Yongchun reign period from Mochuo's name.
Early Guangming forces defeated Guochang; with the Dai north undefended, Taizu attacked, took it, and carried off the populace.
Early in the Guangming era, Guochang was defeated in an attack; with northern Dai undefended, Taizu attacked, took it, and carried off the populace.
攻敗國昌 leaves the attacking subject unstated. The passive preserves that ambiguity without inventing anonymous 'forces.'
After Emperor Muzong's death Jingzong entered to inherit the Guozhong line, taking the style Yuzhuang.
After Emperor Muzong's death, Jingzong left this residence to inherit the imperial succession, and it became known as the imperial estate.
紹國統 means to inherit the imperial succession, while 禦莊 describes the residence as the Imperial Estate rather than supplying Jingzong with a personal style.
